archetype: Elite Aviation (Custom blend of Swiss/High-Contrast & Luxury)
rationale: A premium, authoritative campaign targeting pilots, aircraft owners, and investors. Demands deep navy blues for trust/aviation feel, and vibrant orange (AX10 brand) for high-conversion CTAs. Must render well in both Web and @react-pdf/renderer (which means avoiding complex CSS grids, glassmorphism, and relying on Flexbox, solid colors, and crisp borders).

spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-4xl mx-auto px-6 py-12 md:px-12 md:py-20
spacing_and_layout.pdf_a4_proportions: For PDF, simulate an A4 ratio (approx 1:1.414). Use Flexbox (flex-row, flex-col) exclusively, avoiding CSS Grid for compatibility with @react-pdf/renderer. Use percentage widths (w-1/2, w-1/3) for columns.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none md:rounded-lg (sharp edges convey precision, slightly rounded conveys modern tech)

images.description: Small private airplane flying in the sky
Back view of male pilots in uniform and headset navigating modern airplane

media.qr_code: Generate dynamically using react-qr-code or a placeholder image pointing to https://s.noteall.ru/api/f/MRZkWCgb

hero_section.layout: Relative container with hero background image, dark navy overlay (bg-[#0A1225]/80) for maximum text contrast. Flex-col, text-left.
hero_section.content: Headline 'Поделитесь опытом...' in H1. Sub-block: '30 секунд, чтобы оставить заявку...' styled as a prominent pill or bordered box with an accent left-border (border-l-4 border-orange-500 bg-orange-500/10 p-4).

feature_cards.layout: Flex row, wrap. 3 items taking 33% width on desktop, 100% on mobile.
feature_cards.style: Solid bg-[#121C36], 1px border-[#2A3A60], p-6. Icon in orange.

audience_grid.layout: Flex row wrap, simulating 2 columns (w-1/2) or 3 columns (w-1/3).
audience_grid.style: Cards with solid bg-[#1A2748], p-5. Top border accent (border-t-2 border-transparent hover:border-orange-500).

cta_band.layout: Massive block, bg-[#F97316] (Orange), text-[#0A1225] (Deep Navy) for extreme contrast. Flex row (QR on one side, text/link on the other).
cta_band.content: Include the link https://s.noteall.ru/api/f/MRZkWCgb prominently and the QR code. Ensure the QR code has a white background padding for scanability.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the Web view using React + Tailwind CSS with the colors and typography specified here.

Build the PDF view using @react-pdf/renderer. CRITICAL: Do NOT use CSS Grid (grid-cols-*) or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur) in the PDF component as they are not supported. Use standard flexbox (flex-row, w-1/2, w-1/3) and solid background colors.
Ensure the hero section uses the provided Unsplash airplane image with a heavy dark overlay (opacity 0.8) to guarantee text readability.
Add data-testid attributes to all major interactive elements and blocks.
For the typography, load Montserrat and Manrope via Google Fonts in the Web view.
